evidence.ACL: There is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament.
evidence.MCL: There is complete tear of the medial collateral ligament with distal avulsion of the superficial component
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: There is complete radial tear of the posterior root of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Effusion: There is a large knee joint effusion.
evidence.Contusion: There is also bone contusion involving the anterior aspect of the lateral femoral condyle and minimal contusion at the medial femoral condyle.
evidence.Fracture: There is significant bone marrow edema at the posterior tibial plateau fractures.
